slug: 2025-04-15 Ghana's SIM Registration Goes Fully Online from June 2025

facts.fact: A Ministry update of 11 November 2022 said 30,011,082 people had completed phase-one SIM re-registration linking the Ghana Card to the SIM, of whom 20,892,970 (about 70%) had completed full biometric verification.
The Communications Minister announced on 8 April 2025 that from June 2025 SIM re-registration would be fully online using the Ghana Card, with automatic verification replacing in-person checks.
